meta_title: Young Thurnby Lodge Gardeners | Landscape Leicester
meta_description: Young Thurnby Lodge Gardeners offers professional landscape design and garden maintenance across Leicester. Expert planting, patios, and seasonal care. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Landscape Design & Maintenance — Leicester's Garden Specialists
hero_subhead: Professional landscape design and maintenance that turns neglected outdoor spaces into thriving gardens you'll love spending time in.
services_heading: Complete Landscape Gardening Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From initial design consultation through to ongoing seasonal maintenance, we handle every aspect of your garden's health and beauty.

services.title: Landscape Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke garden designs tailored to your home, lifestyle, and budget. We assess your space, understand your vision, and create a planting scheme that looks beautiful year-round whilst thriving in Leicester's climate.

services.title: Garden Planting & Borders
services.desc: Expert selection and planting of shrubs, perennials, and seasonal colour. We choose plants that suit your soil and light conditions, ensuring strong establishment and long-term growth with minimal fuss.

services.title: Patio & Hardscaping
services.desc: Quality paving, decking, and pathway installation that blends seamlessly with your planting scheme. We use materials built to last Leicester's weather, with proper drainage and solid groundwork.

services.title: Regular Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Scheduled weeding, deadheading, pruning, and seasonal tidying to keep your borders looking cared-for and healthy. Choose fortnightly, monthly, or seasonal visits that fit your needs.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Tree Work
services.desc: Safe, professional pruning and hedge cutting that maintains shape and encourages healthy growth. We handle everything from light shaping to major renovation of overgrown boundaries.

services.title: Spring Cleanup & Autumn Preparation
services.desc: Thorough seasonal work: clearing winter debris, mulching borders, lifting summer bedding, and preparing beds for spring. Gives your garden a fresh start twice a year.

about_pullquote: I started gardening because I wanted to create spaces that make people feel alive.
about_para_1: Young Thurnby Lodge Gardeners was born from a passion for creating outdoor spaces that genuinely improve how you live. Over 18 years, we've transformed hundreds of Leicester gardens—from small urban courtyards to large country plots. Our team combines horticultural knowledge with hands-on craftsmanship; we know what thrives in Leicester's Midlands soil and climate, and we use that expertise on every single project.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our attention to detail and willingness to listen. We don't impose rigid designs or rely on overly trendy planting—instead, we work with you to build something that feels right for your home and genuinely suits how you live. Many of our customers have been with us for years, commissioning seasonal maintenance because they know we'll look after their garden as if it's our own.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: We had a really overgrown, neglected back garden that we didn't know where to start with. The team came out, listened to what we wanted, and designed something completely different to what I'd imagined—but when it went in, it was exactly right. Two years on it's thriving and they still pop round for seasonal maintenance. Absolutely brilliant.
reviews.author: Sarah T.

reviews.text: Had them do a full patio and replanting project last spring. The quality of the work was outstanding—proper drainage, good soil prep, and plants that have actually done well. Not the cheapest quote but you get what you pay for, and I'd rather have it done right once than twice.
reviews.author: Mark D.

reviews.text: Friendly, professional, and they genuinely care about getting the detail right. Came out for a consultation, didn't hard-sell us into anything, and the design they came back with was perfect. Garden's never looked better and they're booked in for spring maintenance already.
reviews.author: Catherine W.
